description:
the senior consultant i \- data engineer provides technical expertise on project tasks under the supervision of a project manager to deliver quality services on schedule, within budget, and in alignment with customer requirements. in this role, the incumbent designs, builds, and maintains data infrastructure and pipelines that support analytics, reporting, and ai/ml systems across the organization. working at the intersection of data engineering, data architecture, and emerging ai tools, the senior consultant i helps ensure data assets are high\-quality, accessible, and properly governed. as part of a project team, this position also maintains relationships with clients and key decision makers to support project success and help identify new business opportunities.


**what you will do:**

* provide technical and project support under the supervision of a project manager to deliver high\-quality services on schedule and within budget.
* assist with project planning, task sequencing, scheduling, research, data analysis, reporting, presentations, and quality assurance.
* work effectively with clients and internal teams, manage multiple assignments, meet deadlines, and adapt to changing project needs.
* support business development by building client relationships, identifying opportunities for additional services, contributing to proposals, and communicating client needs to project managers.
* represent abs group through marketing activities, conference participation, technical whitepapers, and professional networking.
* design, architect, and optimize data pipelines, lakehouse structures, and data models to support analytical reporting and ai/ml initiatives.
* develop, implement, and maintain scalable etl/elt workflows using modern data platforms, cloud\-native technologies, and data engineering best practices.
ensure data quality, pipeline reliability, and system performance through testing, monitoring, validation, and sla\-driven controls.  
* 

**what you will need:**

education and experience


* a minimum of a bachelor’s degree or the equivalent in work experience and training.
* a minimum of 5 years of experience building data pipelines on cloud platforms such as aws, azure, or google cloud.
* demonstrated experience designing and maintaining lakehouse or data warehouse architectures (e.g., databricks, snowflake, redshift, or equivalent).
* proven experience supporting ai/ml workloads through feature engineering, data preparation, or embedding pipelines.
* strong background in data governance, lineage tracking, and quality monitoring in production environments.

knowledge, skills, and abilities


* strong technical learning ability, with the capacity to apply knowledge and support team development.
* ability to mentor junior consultants and share expertise effectively.
* strong client communication and listening skills, with the ability to identify needs and develop solutions.
* adaptable and proactive in supporting change, improving processes, and driving results.
* business\-minded, with an understanding of performance goals and opportunities for growth.
* accountable, dependable, detail\-oriented, and capable of sound independent judgment.
* strong problem\-solving, root cause analysis, and time management skills.
* proficient in python and sql, with familiarity in spark and distributed data processing.
* experience with streaming technologies, ai/ml data systems, data governance tools, docker, and kubernetes.
* working knowledge of health, safety, quality, and environmental management practices.
* ability to learn the abs health, safety, quality, and environmental management systems.

reports to a manager, director, or executive\-level position and does not have any direct reports.

title: Full-Stack PHP Developer
description:
full\-stack php developer


**salary:** $70,000 \- $115,000 doe


**location**: remote (marietta, ga)  

  

**hours:** monday \- friday, 8am \- 5pm eastern

 **about america's best house plans**



america's best house plans is one of the nation's leading online marketplaces for residential home plans. every day, we connect homeowners with architects and designers through a custom\-built ecommerce platform that has been continuously developed and refined over many years.

  

we don’t just maintain a marketing website – we build software. our team of six engineers owns the entire platform, from customer\-facing features to internal tools, search, ecommerce, infrastructure, analytics, and ai initiatives. we value thoughtful engineering, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

 **about the role**



we're looking for an experienced full\-stack php developer who enjoys working across the entire technology stack.



you'll build customer\-facing features, improve internal systems, help maintain our cloud infrastructure, and use ai to make both our customers and our developers more productive.

  

this role is ideal for someone who enjoys variety. one week you may be optimizing sql queries or building new ecommerce functionality. the next you might be improving deployment automation, integrating llms into internal workflows, or diagnosing production performance issues.

  

this position is best suited for engineers who enjoy improving existing systems just as much as building new ones. while we're constantly building new features and modernizing our technology, we also believe that successful software engineering is about making the right technical and business decisions. sometimes the right answer is building something new. sometimes it's thoughtfully enhancing a proven system. we're looking for an engineer who enjoys understanding existing software, improving it where it makes sense, and modernizing it incrementally while balancing business value, maintainability, and risk.



if you're energized by solving complex problems, taking ownership, and leaving a mature system better than you found it, you'll fit right in.

 **what you'll do**


* develop new features for our php\-based ecommerce platform
* improve and modernize existing applications and services
* build responsive interfaces using html, css, and javascript
* design and optimize mysql queries and database schemas
* improve application performance, scalability, and reliability
* maintain linux servers and cloud infrastructure
* enhance ci/cd pipelines and deployment automation
* monitor application health, logging, backups, and system performance
* help design and implement ai\-powered features and internal developer tools
* evaluate and integrate llm apis, prompt engineering techniques, embeddings, and ai workflows where they provide real business value
* participate in architecture discussions and technical planning
* review code and mentor other developers
* troubleshoot production issues across the full stack

 **what we're looking for**


* 7\+ years of professional software development experience
* can comfortably work throughout the entire stack without a framework (using vanilla php, html, css and javascript)
* experience building ai\-powered applications
* experience improving developer productivity through automation and ai
* excellent mysql and sql optimization skills
* experience working directly on linux servers
* experience with git and collaborative development workflows
* solid understanding of http, rest apis, caching, sessions, authentication, and web security
* comfortable debugging issues across frontend, backend, database, and infrastructure
* enjoys owning problems from beginning to end
* takes pride in writing maintainable, practical code that is easy for others to read
* makes pragmatic engineering decisions based on business value, reliability, and long\-term maintainability
* understands that not every problem requires a rewrite—and knows when modernization creates value versus unnecessary risk
* uses ai as a force multiplier—not a replacement for engineering judgment

 **why join us?**


* small engineering team with significant ownership and impact
* modernize and improve an established, successful platform
* work directly with decision\-makers
* opportunity to shape our ai strategy and product direction
* variety of technical challenges across software development and infrastructure
* excellent benefits package

  



if you're excited about building software, improving systems, and helping shape how ai is applied in a real business, we'd love to hear from you.

title: AI Engineer Intern
description:
**about the role**

your primary focus for this internship is agent systems — planning, tool\-calling, and memory — with additional exposure to candidate\-job matching algorithms and workflow automation modules.

**what you'll do**

\- help design and validate components of agent systems with planning, tool\-calling, and memory capabilities

\- participate in experiments to improve multi\-agent collaboration and workflow orchestration

\- work with engineers to iterate on and test algorithms for candidate\-job matching, skill extraction, and candidate attribute inference

\- contribute to llm performance optimization, including prompt iteration, rag retrieval improvements, model routing, and related experiments

\- help build evaluation datasets and model evaluation workflows, and contribute to the design of relevant evaluation metrics

\- participate in the full lifecycle of ai features, from development and experimentation to testing and production launch, in a fast\-moving startup environment

**requirements**

\- currently pursuing a bachelor's degree or above, including graduating students who are still eligible for internships

\- able to commit to at least 3 months, with availability for 4 or more days per week

\- strong foundations in python and backend development, with hands\-on experience in at least one of the following: fastapi, node.js, or go

\- genuine interest in and foundational understanding of llms and ai agents, with the ability to clearly explain core concepts such as rag and tool calling (prior experience independently building a complete llm project is not required)

\- strong ownership, initiative, and bias toward action, with the ability to make progress in ambiguous and fast\-changing environments

\- solid engineering fundamentals, including the ability to read and contribute to an existing codebase, debug issues, and identify root causes

\- experience with llm or agent\-related coursework, hackathon projects, research projects, or personal github demos (production\-level experience is not required)

\- familiarity with infrastructure technologies such as docker, kubernetes, kafka, asynchronous task queues, or similar systems

\- exposure to or strong interest in model fine\-tuning, open\-source contributions, or startup environments

\- curiosity about recruiting, organizational design, talent systems, or hrtech, and a willingness to quickly learn the domain

**about company**

brix is a silicon valley–born ai company incubated by hf0, a leading startup accelerator. we believe ai will not only transform how people work, but also fundamentally redefine how companies find talent, build teams, and collaborate globally.

to make this possible, we are building the world’s first proactive ai workforce agent.

companies simply tell brix what problem they want to solve. our agent can understand the business objective, analyze the global talent market, recommend hiring and team\-building strategies, and continue executing across the entire workflow—from candidate sourcing and outreach to interviewing, hiring, and global employment.

powered by a2a (agent\-to\-agent) technology, brix coordinates different ai agents, professional recruiting experts, and global employment services to transform today’s fragmented, inefficient, and opaque hiring process into a continuous, outcome\-driven workflow. at the same time, we aim to give talent a fairer and more transparent way to discover opportunities that truly fit them.

since our founding, brix has helped 500\+ leading silicon valley ai companies build global teams, connected 960m\+ global talent profiles, and generated more than $40m in business volume within 20 months.

we also built remote 101, one of the most active remote\-work communities connecting north america and asia, helping people from diverse backgrounds find meaningful opportunities around the world.

our core team includes alumni from google, meta, amazon, tiktok, bcg, and other leading technology and consulting companies, bringing together deep expertise in engineering, product development, and global operations.

joining brix means working on more than a traditional recruiting product. you will help build a new way for organizations to operate—where companies assemble teams around problems and humans and ai work together more effectively.

* flexible schedule

work location: hybrid remote in palo alto, ca 94303

title: Data Engineer
description:
description:
**job status:** exempt (non\-management)

**reports to:** chief information officer

**supervises:** none

**who we are:** at central one, our values are to deliver exceptional service, work as a team, have fun, and the credit union philosophy of people helping people; all while striving to be c.e.n.t.r.a.l. one ambassadors. central stands for caring, enthusiastic, nimble, team\-oriented, resilient, altruistic and loyal. at the core of our values lies a commitment to our community, members, and employees, with a focus on overall well\-being.

**primary functions:**


the data engineer owns the design, build, and ongoing development of cofcu’s enterprise data infrastructure — a modern, scalable platform built on azure and microsoft fabric. this role is the technical engine behind cofcu’s data strategy, responsible for delivering the pipelines, lakehouses, semantic models, and integrations that power trusted reporting, analytics, and ai capabilities across the organization.


the data engineer does not work in isolation. this role operates as a collaborative lead within the data infrastructure team, working closely with business department leaders, data domain owners, the data \& ai governance lead, and cofcu’s managed service provider (msp) to continuously build, refine, and scale the infrastructure. the data engineer is also an active participant in the data \& ai governance framework — applying governance standards, enabling technical implementation of policies, and serving as a technical representative on the data \& ai governance committee.


this position is foundational to cofcu’s shift from manual reporting to a governed, enterprise\-wide data ecosystem — and plays a central role in enabling leadership and staff to access timely, trusted insights that support strategic decision\-making.

**duties and responsibilities:**

**data infrastructure ownership \& development**


own the enterprise data platform end\-to\-end and drive its ongoing evolution in partnership with the msp, domain owners, and it leadership.

* serve as the primary technical owner of cofcu’s data infrastructure, including the data lakehouse/warehouse, ingestion pipelines, transformation layers, and semantic models built on azure and microsoft fabric.
* lead and manage the day\-to\-day execution of the data infrastructure team workstreams, coordinating with the msp to ensure deliverables align with project scope, timelines, and cofcu standards.
* partner with business departments and data domain owners (member, financial, lending, operational, employee, and vendor data) to understand data needs and translate them into infrastructure design and build requirements.
* build and maintain scalable data ingestion, transformation, and storage pipelines for structured and unstructured data from diverse sources including core banking systems, saas platforms, apis, and flat files.
* automate data processing workflows to reduce manual effort, improve reliability, and increase timeliness of data availability.
* manage microsoft purview configuration, data classification, and cataloging as part of the technical governance infrastructure.

title: Senior Agentic AI Engineer
description:
**job summary:**


the senior agentic ai engineer is the operational owner of the constituent data layer (cdl) and the safe, secure rollout of ai agents across catertrax® constituent surfaces.  

  

reporting to the director, enterprise architecture as a member of the data layer group, this engineer manages the cdl schema, the agent registry, and the policy engine that governs which agents can access which data under which conditions, and instruments the data flywheel that returns outcomes from agent actions back into the layer.  

  

the role partners with the director of strategic solutions on brief\-to\-agent translation, with the director, product and solutions on engineering intake, with platform engineering on runtime, and with finance on data flywheel roi metrics. without this role, agents would be built ad hoc across teams with no shared governance; this seat ensures they are not.**job description:**

**essential duties and responsibilities**
-----------------------------------------

**constituent data layer ownership**

* manage the constituent data layer schema, including versioning, integrity, and evolution as constituent surfaces expand.
* own the agent registry: the authoritative record of every agent operating across catertrax surfaces.
* build and operate the policy engine governing which agents can access which data under which conditions.
* establish and maintain shared governance so agents are built on the cdl rather than ad hoc across teams.

**agent development \& safe rollout**

* design, build, and deploy ai agents across constituent surfaces on the shared platform substrate.
* implement guardrails, evaluation harnesses, and monitoring for agent behavior in production.
* define and operate the rollout process for new agents, including staged release, human oversight, and rollback.
* lead incident response for agent behavior issues, including root\-cause analysis and remediation.

 **data flywheel \& measurement**

* instrument the data flywheel that returns outcomes from agent actions back into the constituent data layer.
* partner with finance to define and report data flywheel roi metrics.
* ensure agent telemetry supports both product improvement and executive decision\-making.

**cross\-functional partnership**

* partner with the director of strategic solutions on brief\-to\-agent translation, converting constituent problem framing into agent designs.
* partner with the director, product and solutions on engineering intake and sequencing.
* partner with platform engineering on agent runtime, deployment, and operational readiness.

**engineering excellence**

* uphold engineering standards, code review practices, and documentation quality across all data layer work.
* embed security and privacy by design into every agent and data\-layer decision.

**qualifications and experience includes**
------------------------------------------

**education**


bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related technical discipline required.


master's degree preferred.

**experience**


required:

* 6\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 2\+ years building llm\-based or ai\-powered systems in production.
* hands\-on experience with retrieval\-augmented generation (rag), vector databases, and prompt/agent design patterns.
* strong data modeling and api design skills, including schema governance in a shared\-platform context.
* experience implementing evaluation, monitoring, and guardrails for ai systems in production.
* proficiency in python and/or a modern backend language used in production services.


preferred:

* experience with agent orchestration frameworks, agent registries, or policy/authorization engines.
* experience in foodservice technology, hospitality tech, or b2b saas platforms.
* familiarity with responsible ai practices, ai governance frameworks, and data privacy regulations.

**skills and competency requirements**

* ownership: treats the constituent data layer as a product with constituents, not a project with tasks.
* safety mindset: designs for what agents must never do before optimizing what they can do.
* pragmatic shipping: delivers working, governed capability iteratively rather than perfect systems slowly.
* cross\-functional translation: moves fluently between constituent problem language and engineering design.
* documentation discipline: leaves every schema, agent, and policy legible to the next engineer.
* curiosity: tracks the rapidly evolving agentic ai landscape and applies it judiciously.

**technology skills**


the senior agentic ai engineer is expected to bring deep hands\-on proficiency across the following technology domains.


 ai \& machine learning platforms

* large language model (llm) platforms: openai / azure openai, anthropic claude, aws bedrock, or equivalent.
* agent orchestration frameworks, function/tool calling, and multi\-agent patterns.
* retrieval\-augmented generation (rag) architecture and vector database platforms.
* ai ops tooling for model monitoring, versioning, drift detection, and deployment pipelines.


 cloud \& infrastructure

* cloud platforms: proficiency in microsoft azure, with fluency across aws and google cloud.
* containerization and orchestration: docker and kubernetes.
* serverless and event\-driven architecture patterns.


 data \& analytics

* sql, relational, and vector databases.
* data pipeline and transformation tooling.
* schema design, data contracts, and data governance practices.


 software engineering \& devops

* source control and collaboration: git, github, or gitlab, including pr workflows and code review practices.
* ci/cd pipeline platforms: github, azure devops.
* api design and management; identity and access patterns (oauth 2\.0, sso/saml).

 productivity \& collaboration

* microsoft 365 suite: teams, sharepoint, excel, and powerpoint.

* 5\+ years of experience working with terraform/infrastructure as code concepts
* 5\+ years work with continuous integration and build tools
* experience architecting and designing systems from the ground up, including making pragmatic decisions for scalability, reliability, and maintainability.

**job description**
-------------------


pse’s communications strategy team is looking for a marketing data scientist to lead the development, measurement, and optimization of marketing, customer engagement, and communications performance through advanced analytics, data science, and business intelligence. this role integrates marketing strategy with data\-driven insights to support companywide marketing efforts and corporate priorities. the most successful candidate will be able to use storytelling to present data to internal and external stakeholders, translate data into actionable items, and move data between multiple sources and programs.

  

the responsibilities of this role combine statistical analysis, machine learning, and business analytics to evaluate campaign performance, forecast customer behavior, and optimize marketing effectiveness. additionally they develop production\-quality models, dashboards, and reporting frameworks that enable data\-driven decision\-making across marketing and customer experience functions.

  

the marketing data scientist will need to partner cross\-functionally with marketing, customer insights, analytics, regulatory, and external agencies to deliver actionable insights that improve engagement, enhance customer experience, and support corporate goals.

  

all pse employees are expected to uphold the safety compliance standards inherent in pse’s operating and/or field procedures related to work responsibilities and promote and support a culture of total safety. additionally, employees need to demonstrate commitment to conduct business honestly, ethically and consistent with our core values and code of conduct. all duties are to be performed in accordance with all regulatory compliance obligations.

* design and manage kpis to evaluate marketing effectiveness.
* develop machine learning models to predict customer behavior and optimize marketing outcomes.
* perform data mining and advanced analytics on large datasets.
* develop and maintain dashboards and reporting frameworks.

* performs other duties as assigned.

* bachelor’s degree in computer science, mathematics, statistics, economics, finance, data science or other relevant quantitative field; or equivalent experience.
* at least one year experience in applying quantitative methods and building production quality machine learning models in a classroom, or laboratory setting.
* undergraduate degrees in data science satisfy the one year experience requirement.
* proficiency with python or r.
* strong working knowledge of sql.
* experience with visualization tools like tableau or power bi.
* ability to synthesize large quantities of statistical data and complex analyses into actionable information.
* ability to collaborate and participate in direct data science and data management projects and project teams.
* familiar with all categories of security and regulated data and information.

title: Senior Automation Engineer
description:
**automation engineer – power automate (healthcare operations)**

**contract to permanent**

**job summary** we are seeking a seasoned senior automation engineer to lead the rapid delivery of high\-impact automation solutions within a healthcare payer environment. in this role, you will act as a lead developer and lead automation solution design. you will be responsible for analyzing complex business workflows in clinical, enrollment, provider, it operations etc and converting them into streamlined, automated processes. you will own the assessment phase to identify repetitive, rules\-based tasks that offer the highest roi and build robust, scalable solutions. you will prioritize modern generative ai approaches over legacy rpa methods where applicable to reduce maintenance overhead.

**key responsibilities**

* process mining and discovery: lead workshops with business stakeholders in enrollment, provider, clinical, it etc to map workflows. identify manual, repetitive workflows with clear logic and quantify the potential time savings and roi of automation.
* automation solution: design end\-to\-end automation workflows that integrate modern cloud apps like sharepoint with specific healthcare and data systems including careradius, anchor point, and databricks.
* generative ai implementation: leverage ai tools such as gemini to replace complex rule\-based scraping with intelligent parsing. design workflows that use large language models to summarize clinical notes or extract data from unstructured provider emails instead of building brittle rpa loops.
* advanced development: build complex, automations using power automate desktop (and similar rpas) and cloud flows. handle advanced logic, error handling, and exception management using modern ai connectors.
* governance and mentorship: establish coding standards and secure by design principles for the automation team. provide technical guidance and code reviews for the junior automation engineer.
* integration strategy: write custom connectors or scripts using powershell, python, or json to bridge gaps where out\-of\-the\-box connectors do not exist.

**education and experience**

* **education:** bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related technical field.
* **experience:**


	+ 8\+ years in software development or data engineering, with a strong emphasis on etl
	+ 5\+ years expert\-level proficiency in microsoft power platform including power automate cloud and desktop. strong proficiency in api integration via rest or soap and sql.
	+ 5\+ years of extensive experience working with sql databases, nosql environments, and complex api integrations within a healthcare context.
	+ proven success in processing large volumes of unstructured medical data using ocr, nlp, and document ai technologies.
	+ experience building automated testing frameworks to validate the accuracy of ai outputs in regulated environments.
	+ leadership in managing the deployment of bots in virtualized environments and ensuring 24/7 operational stability.
	+ demonstrated ability to use generative ai tools like gemini, claude, or openai apis to solve automation problems. experience prompting llms to structure unstructured data.
	+ proven experience automating workflows in a healthcare payer setting such as enrollment processing, provider credentialing, or clinical prior authorization.

**competencies**

* **full stack capability:** ability to move seamlessly between low\-code environments and pro\-code development (python/c\#) as project requirements dictate.
* **data fluency:** deep understanding of etl pipelines, data cleaning, and the transformation of unstructured healthcare data into vectorized formats.
* **operational strategic thinking:** ability to identify systemic workflow constraints and formulate long\-term technical solutions that move beyond simple task automation to create end\-to\-end autonomous processes.
* **legacy system navigation:** specialized knowledge in extracting and injecting data into healthcare\-specific legacy applications without native api support.
* **performance tuning:** expertise in optimizing script execution and bot performance to minimize latency and resource consumption.

 **nice to have**

* healthcare systems or sensitive data experience
* sharepoint automation, scripting (python/powershell), or rpa tools


if you enjoy taking messy manual processes and turning them into reliable systems that people depend on daily, this role will be a great fit.

we are looking for an experienced software engineer to join our instrument software team. this team develops software that is an integral part of illumina’s growing fleet of next generation sequencing (ngs) and related products . this role requires a professional with experience developing and delivering complex software projects. this crucial role focuses on developing mission\-critical platform services responsible for the reliable movement, storage, and management of sequencing data generated by illumina instruments. these services must operate reliably in the presence of network interruptions, system restarts, power loss events, and other real\-world failures while ensuring data integrity and recoverability.

* **education:** bachelor's degree in a relevant engineering field (e.g., computer science, biomedical engineering, software engineering).

* **troubleshooting and problem** **solving** **:** demonstrated experience designing and implementing fault\-tolerant distributed or multi\-process systems. experience with retry strategies, durable state management, idempotent operations, concurrency, asynchronous processing, and system recovery techniques is highly desirable.

* **domain knowledge:** proven ability to analyze and contribute to software component design. knowledge of hardware development, medical software, healthcare regulations, cybersecurity best practices , network protocols, or file transfer protocols are all highly desirable. experience with ngs and bioinformatics is a plus.

* proven track record of designing and implementing robust software solutions that meet demanding resiliency, availability, and performance objectives .
* required experience with tools such as j ira , confluence, github , github actions, teamcity , jenkins or their equivalents .

title: UI Desktop Engineer Hybird
location: Research Triangle Park, NC, US USA
description:
**the application window is expected to close on:** 09/21/2026job posting may be removed earlier if the position is filled or if a sufficient number of applications are received.
  
  

meet the team
  
  

our team is part of the cisco ai and automation portfolio, responsible for the"circui" platform—the central ai engine that powers productivity and process automation for all of cisco. we are a rapidly expanding, high\-impact group dedicated to building the vehicle for ai\-driven business transformation. we operate at the intersection of applied research and production, ensuring our technology is not only cutting\-edge but also optimized for performance, reliability, and functional quality for our 80,000\+ monthly users.
  
as a desktop ui developer, you will lead the greenfield effort to bring circuit to the desktop—building a persistent, ambient, native\-grade experience for macos and windows that lives where our users work.
  
  

your impact
  
  

as a desktop ui developer, you will design and build the circuit desktop application—a native\-grade, cross\-platform experience for macos and windows that brings ai\-driven productivity to the desktop. you bring the full skill set of a modern web ui developer (angular, node.js, gcp, figma\-driven ux, rest apis) and extend it to the desktop, bridging the gap between our web application and the operating system.
  
**you will own the desktop shell end\-to\-end:** application lifecycle, os\-level integrations (system tray, notifications, deep linking, always\-on presence), installers, and safe auto\-updates. this is a high\-visibility, high\-ownership role where you will define how tens of thousands of cisco employees experience circuit as a first\-class desktop citizen.
  
  

responsibilities
  
  

design, build, and maintain the circuit desktop application for macos and windows using electron (or tauri) with an angular/typescript ui, ensuring a consistent, performant, native\-grade experience across both platforms.
  
  

implement desktop\-specific functionality—system tray, native notifications, file system access, deep linking, global shortcuts, and always\-on ambient presence—architecting clean ipc communication between the ui (renderer) and main processes with context isolation and sandboxing.
  
  

build responsive ai\-driven interfaces (chat, agents, streaming responses) from figma designs and ux frameworks, integrating with rest apis and node.js services, and reusing circuit's web design system on the desktop surface.
  
  

own cross\-platform build pipelines and installers (dmg/pkg for macos, msi/nsis for windows), including code signing and macos notarization, hardened runtime, and reliable differential auto\-updates.
  
  

integrate native modules where needed (swift/objective\-c on macos, c\+\+/c\# on windows), and profile and optimize startup time, memory, and cpu usage; debug native crashes and manage large local state (sqlite/indexeddb).
  
  

deploy supporting services on google cloud platform, contribute to a multi\-platform ci/cd matrix, and collaborate within an agile team of designers, backend, platform, and quality engineers.
  
  

work with ux and ui designers throughout the product lifecycle, from early feasibility conversations through build and release. participate in design reviews, give honest input on what is feasible in code, and help scope work so designs can ship without last\-minute compromises.
  
  

build interfaces using a shared component library and design tokens, extending existing patterns instead of writing one\-off styles. keep ui consistent, theme\-aware, and maintainable as the product grows.
  
  

implement wcag 2\.2 aa patterns for dynamic ai interfaces, including aria live regions for streaming responses, semantic structure for conversation uis, focus management across modals and context switches, full keyboard support, and color contrast in light and dark modes.
  
  

**research\-informed implementation:** apply findings from usability testing and end\-user feedback during development. know when a design is ready to build versus still in exploration, and raise gaps or edge cases with designers before they become production issues.
  
  

**human\-ai interaction ui:** build front\-end patterns that help users understand ai behavior: streaming and token\-by\-token rendering, clear loading and error states, recovery flows when responses fail, and ui that supports trust and comprehension in non\-deterministic experiences. this is a hybrid position.
  
  

minimum qualifications
  
  

* bachelor’s degree with 6\+ years, master’s degree with 4\+ years, or phd with 1\+ year of experience in computer science or a related technical field.
* proficiency in angular, typescript/javascript, and node.js, with a strong focus on translating figma designs into scalable, component\-based uis using formal design systems.
* proven ability to build and ship secure production desktop applications for macos and windows using electron or tauri, with deep knowledge of application lifecycles, ipc, and security best practices.
* experience managing cross\-platform packaging, code signing, and auto\-update mechanisms, complemented by practical experience deploying and running services on google cloud platform (gcp).
* proficiency in git and agile methodologies, with a specialized focus on implementing advanced accessibility standards for dynamic, real\-time web uis.


preferred qualifications

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer — AI Agent Systems
description:
**senior full\-stack engineer \- ai agent systems**

taxflow · accounting \& taxation platform · full\-time · remote (usa\-based)

**about taxflow**

taxflow is a tax\-preparation platform for cpa firms. we take the most document\-heavy, deadline\-driven workflow in professional services \- the annual tax return \- and rebuild it around ai: documents arrive, get classified and extracted by an agent pipeline, land in a per\-return workspace ("binder") as reviewable, cited values, and flow through preparation workpapers to the firm’s tax software. firms keep the judgment; the platform does the shuffling.

this is real\-money, real\-compliance software. taxpayer pii, irs pub 4557 / ftc safeguards obligations, audit trails, immutable records. accuracy is not a nice\-to\-have \- it is the product.

**the role**

you’ll be the second engineer, working directly with the founding team across the whole platform \- and you’ll do it in an **agent\-native workflow**: we build with parallel ai coding agents, where engineers set direction, write sharp specs, review rigorously, and orchestrate agent teams rather than typing every line. if your instinct on a complex migration is "spec it precisely, fan it out, verify adversarially," you’ll feel at home.

your center of gravity:

* **ai / agent systems (the core of the role).** design and harden the document\-intelligence pipeline: multi\-step agent harnesses for classification, extraction, and review of tax documents (w\-2s, k\-1s, 1099s, organizers, prior\-year returns); prompt/tool design; structured outputs; confidence scoring and citation of extracted values; evals and regression suites so quality is measured, not vibes.
* **backend.** postgres data modeling in a strictly multi\-tenant schema (70\+ tables, db\-first with drizzle), server functions, background job orchestration (inngest), document storage (r2/s3\), and vendor integrations \- cch axcess import/export, irs mef, third\-party extraction apis \- kept behind clean adapter seams.
* **full\-stack product.** ship vertical slices end to end in our tanstack start \+ react app: extraction\-review uis, spreadsheet\-grade workpapers, pipeline/kanban views. you don’t need to be a designer; you do need to care that a preparer can trust what’s on screen.
* **devops (a solid working share).** own our path from "works locally" to boring, observable production on **aws**: deploy pipelines, ci, environments and secrets, monitoring/alerting, backup and retention posture, and the data\-residency/security requirements that come with taxpayer data. nothing exotic \- it just has to be right, because tax season doesn’t reschedule.

**our stack (what you’d actually touch)**

* **monorepo:** turborepo \+ pnpm, node 24, typescript end to end, vitest
* **app:** tanstack start (ssr react), tailwind v4, shadcn/ui on base ui primitives
* **data:** postgresql (neon in prod, docker locally), drizzle orm, db\-first schema, firm\_id tenancy on every domain table
* **ai:** multi\-provider llm stack (anthropic claude today, provider\-agnostic by design \- openai, gemini, and open models where they fit) driving the agent pipeline for document classification, extraction, and review; structured outputs, per\-document extraction specs, eval harnesses
* **jobs \& storage:** inngest, cloudflare r2 / s3\-compatible storage (minio locally)
* **auth:** self\-hosted better auth
* **integrations:** cch axcess bridge, irs mef, summedd extraction api \- isolated adapters
* **hosting:** aws (production); github\-based flow

**what you’ve done before (requirements)**

* **6\+ years building production software**, with at least 2 recent years shipping **llm/agent\-powered features** to real users \- agent loops or harnesses, tool use / function calling, rag or document pipelines, eval frameworks. you can talk concretely about failure modes you hit and how you measured your way out.
* **strong backend fundamentals:** relational data modeling, transactions, migrations, queues/background jobs, idempotency, api design. comfortable owning a postgres schema that other things depend on.
* **fluent typescript across the stack** and at ease in a modern react codebase (we use tanstack start; next.js experience translates fine).
* **enough devops to own production:** aws experience \- ci/cd, environment/secret management, networking basics, monitoring, and incident hygiene. you’ve stood up and run production infrastructure yourself, not just consumed someone else’s.
* **rigor.** you write specs before code when it matters, test what can silently be wrong, and treat "the model said so" as a hypothesis, not an answer.
* comfortable working **with ai coding agents** as a force multiplier \- directing, reviewing, and correcting them \- not threatened by them, not blindly trusting them.

**nice to have**

* fintech, accounting, tax, or other regulated/compliance\-heavy domain experience (pii handling, audit trails, retention/worm, soc 2 groundwork)
* document\-ai specifics: ocr/vision\-model extraction, layout parsing, confidence calibration, human\-in\-the\-loop review ux
* experience with any of: drizzle, inngest, better auth, neon, cloudflare r2, turborepo
* prior early\-stage experience \- you’ve been engineer \#1–5 somewhere and know what "owning it" means

**how we work**

* **small, senior, direct.** you work with the founding team daily; decisions are made in hours, not sprints.
* **agent\-native development.** plans and specs live in the repo; ai coding agents do much of the mechanical work in parallel; humans own architecture, correctness, and review. the bottleneck we care about is ambiguity, not typing speed.
* **vertical slices, verified end to end.** no layer\-by\-layer phases; everything ships behind quality gates (typecheck, tests) with real data flowing.
* **correctness culture.** tax numbers, tenancy boundaries, and audit trails get the paranoid treatment: root\-cause fixes over patches, tests over promises.

**details**

* **compensation:** usd 120,000 – 130,000
* **location:** remote, usa\-based. mid to west coast preferred for timezone. you will need timezone overlap with both new york and sydney, australia. rare travel to new york for an in\-person meeting may be required.
* **start:** as soon as you can

**hiring process**

1\. **intro call** (30 min) \- mutual fit, your ai/agent war stories

2\. **technical deep\-dive** (60 min) \- walk us through a system you built: an agent pipeline or a backend you owned; we’ll dig into the decisions

3\. **working test session** \- a realistic slice of our world (e.g. design an extraction eval, or spec \+ build a small vertical slice with agent tooling)

4\. **final discussion and offer**

**to apply**

email **jobs@summedd.com**. include something you’ve built with llms that you’re proud of \- a repo, a demo, or a write\-up of the hard parts.

pay: $120,000\.00 \- $130,000\.00 per year

work location: remote

linevision is a grid\-enhancing technology company enabling electric utilities to deliver affordable, reliable power and accelerate the electrification of the global economy. our grid intelligence platform delivers the most accurate, network\-wide dynamic line ratings and enables safer, more reliable grid operations with a combination of optical sensors and advanced environmental modeling. linevision's global customer base includes eight of the ten largest us utilities, including national grid, southern company, and exelon.

hands\-on experience performing vulnerability remediation and secure coding implementation across salesforce applications and integrations.
  
strong expertise with sast and security analysis tools including checkmarx, salesforce code analyzer, pmd, and sonarqube.

experience in banking or financial services environments.
  
hands\-on experience conducting salesforce org health reviews, technical assessments, and governance evaluations.

ontic provides software that helps corporate and government security teams identify threats, assess risk, and respond faster to keep people and organizations safe. its ai\-powered connected intelligence platform unifies security operations and data into a centralized system of record, enabling organizations to conduct risk assessments, protect against workplace violence, and manage threats and incidents more efficiently. fortune 500 companies and federal agencies rely on ontic to support security programs such as executive protection, threat intelligence, and corporate investigations. learn more at ontic.ai or follow us on linkedin.

* comfort working in a fast\-moving, evolving ai tooling landscape

we are not building a traditional bi function.


we are building an ai\-augmented analytics capability that:

you won’t just build dashboards — you will help shape how analytics and ai power our company over the next several years.

title: Data Scientist
description:
**company description**  

at ipt global, we’re pioneers in providing innovative digital solutions for well integrity assurance and energy technology. our mission is to empower operators with the data, tools, and insights they need to ensure safer, more reliable operations.


we combine deep domain expertise with cutting\-edge software development to deliver high\-quality applications and platforms that enhance performance, safety, and efficiency across the energy lifecycle. our teams collaborate across disciplines, embracing creativity, accountability, and continuous learning to drive technological progress and deliver lasting value to our customers.


if you want to work in an environment that values growth, innovation, and teamwork — we’d love to meet you.

 **job description**  

* leverage strong data science skills throughout the data analysis process (problem formulation, data aggregation, transformation and cleaning, descriptive analysis, modeling, visualization, presentation, productizing)
* design and execute research of open\-ended problems related to data analytics, machine learning, and predictive modeling on large, complex data sets to draw insights and conclusions for key stakeholders
* evaluate, improve, and invent analysis methods to be used in ipt global’s suite of well integrity solutions
* develop and validate proposed analysis methods through the application of physics\-based and data\-based models to industry component data sets, apply variances to account for test environment effects and signal noise to gauge algorithm performance and robustness
* collaborate with multiple teams and present findings, prototypes, and recommendations periodically to multiple levels of stakeholders, including to senior management
* leverage existing data sets to improve/invent analysis methods and solutions by performing data analysis on large sets of data identifying trends, patterns, anomalies, clusters, and insights in a continual advancement of our state\-of\-the\-art
* perform statistical analysis of field and simulated data to provide reliability insights, confidence levels, and risk assessments
* support business development through projects evaluating client/prospect data and potential improvements in reliability and efficiency using ipt products
* analyze operational data, create kpis, and develop dashboards or visualizations that drive action and provide business value for internal and external clients
* participate in technical document generation and research publication writing, and present research at national/international conferences and forums in fields related to the role
* document innovations in the consideration and protection of intellectual property (e.g., patent applications, trade secrets)
* all other assigned duties

  

**qualifications** **requirements**

* bachelor's or master’s degree in a quantitative discipline (e.g., mathematics, statistics, engineering, computer science, physics, applied science) or related discipline with demonstrated research capability
* 3 years of direct work experience in a data related field
* proficiency in statistical/numerical analysis concepts: regression, linear and multivariate analysis, curve\-fitting, sampling methods, descriptive statistics, probability distributions, stochastic models, confidence/risk analysis, optimization
* experience with statistical/numerical software (e.g., r, python, matlab), database query languages (e.g., sql), and data science toolkits (e.g., tensorflow, keras)

**preferred skills**

* 5\+ years of relevant work experience, including expertise with statistical data analysis
* proficiency in implementing machine learning and deep learning techniques and algorithms (e.g., knn, naïve bayes, svm, decision forest, randomforest, gradient boosting, cnn) and applying model validation concepts
* experience in predictive and prescriptive modeling, including model training and validation
* familiarity with azure, or other cloud computing services (aws, google cloud, etc.)
* familiarity with c\#, virtual machines / containers
* history of generating technical documents and publications
* experience in the oil and gas industry, especially operations, and understanding of industry common terminology

  

**additional information*** **location:** houston, texas
* **employment type:** full\-time, flexible schedule
* **compensation:** competitive compensation commensurate with experience, plus comprehensive benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k), paid time off).
* **work environment:** collaborative and innovative team culture focused on continuous improvement and professional growth.


join ipt global and help us shape the next generation of software that supports the energy industry’s drive toward safety, efficiency, and innovation.

title: C# Developer Intern
description:
we are seeking a driven and intellectually curious c\# software developer intern to join our dynamic trading firm. this is an exceptional opportunity to gain hands\-on experience building high\-performance trading systems and commercializing financial technology products while contributing meaningfully to our operations. you will work closely with experienced engineers in a mentorship\-rich environment, learning modern c\# development practices, full\-stack application design, and how to translate trading concepts into efficient technical solutions. this internship is designed to accelerate your growth as a software engineer while you help develop platforms and tools that directly power our trading operations. if you thrive on learning, enjoy solving complex technical problems, and want to understand how modern financial technology works at scale, this is the role for you.

**key responsibilities**
========================

* develop trading components: under mentor guidance, implement features for automated trading systems and client\-facing applications, learning how to design algorithms and apis that solve real trader problems.
* product development: contribute to transforming existing trading platforms into market\-ready commercial products, understanding the full lifecycle from internal tool to polished external offering.
* full\-stack development: gain experience across the development spectrum—from backend algorithm implementation to api design to front\-end application interfaces—in both windows and linux environments.
* code quality \& architecture: learn and apply solid principles and modern c\# patterns through hands\-on code reviews, pair programming, and collaborative design discussions.
* performance optimization: participate in profiling and optimizing system components; understand techniques for building responsive, efficient applications.
* collaborative problem\-solving: work alongside traders and analysts to translate complex trading needs into technical solutions, developing your communication and domain knowledge.
* documentation \& knowledge sharing: document code, design decisions, and lessons learned to build your technical communication skills and support the team.

**required skills and qualifications**
======================================

* strong foundation in c\#: solid grasp of c\# fundamentals, including object\-oriented programming, async/await patterns, and the .net ecosystem. production experience not required; demonstrated projects or coursework show readiness.
* core cs fundamentals: comfortable with data structures, algorithms, and basic systems concepts (threading, synchronization, network basics).
* quick learner: able to rapidly pick up new tools, libraries, frameworks, and platforms with minimal guidance.
* linux \& windows familiarity: comfortable working in both operating environments; understanding how c\# and .net behave across platforms is valuable.
* collaborative mindset: excellent communication skills; eager to learn from mentors, ask clarifying questions, and work effectively in a team.

**preferred skills**
====================

* multi\-threaded \& async programming: practical experience with concurrent programming, thread safety, async/await patterns, or synchronization primitives.
* web api development: exposure to building rest apis, http protocols, or api design patterns.
* front\-end development: experience with ui frameworks (windows forms, wpf, or web frameworks) or interest in full\-stack development.
* additional languages: proficiency in c\+\+, python, javascript, or other languages broadens your perspective on systems design.
* financial markets interest: curiosity about trading, equities, options, or how financial markets work—we teach the rest.
* database experience: familiarity with sql or nosql databases; understanding of data modeling and query optimization.
* devops \& ci/cd basics: exposure to git, ci/cd pipelines, docker, or deployment processes.
* version control \& tooling: experience with git, debugging tools, or profilers.

**personal attributes**
=======================

* intellectual curiosity: genuine interest in understanding how systems work, from code architecture to infrastructure to business outcomes.
* growth mindset: embrace challenges and feedback as opportunities to learn. we expect you to grow significantly over the internship.
* ownership \& initiative: proactive in seeking learning opportunities and taking on well\-scoped responsibilities with decreasing oversight.
* adaptability: comfortable with ambiguity and rapid changes; thriving in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.
* collaborative problem\-solving: strong analytical skills with a preference for brainstorming, code reviews, and learning from teammates.
* passion for technology: excitement about modern c\# features, software design patterns, and building tools that solve real problems.

  

what you'll gain

  

* hands\-on production experience: work with real, production trading systems and commercial products—not toy projects or tutorials. your code is used by traders and clients.
* mentorship from experts: learn directly from senior engineers with deep expertise in c\#, full\-stack development, trading systems, and financial technology.
* full\-stack understanding: gain experience across the entire development lifecycle—from api design to front\-end interfaces to performance optimization and deployment.
* domain knowledge: build genuine understanding of financial trading, equities, options, and how traders actually use the tools you build.
* career acceleration: build a portfolio of impactful, real\-world projects and establish relationships with leaders in fintech.
* potential for conversion: strong performers are considered for full\-time roles upon graduation or at the conclusion of the internship.

 **compensation**: this internship is paid at $7,000 per month for the program.

title: Data Engineer
description:
**overview**
------------


at ford, you’ll work on ideas that matter, alongside passionate people who want to make a global impact. together, we’re shaping the next era of transportation—grounded in purpose, driven by progress. make your move.


* job type: full time
* work type: hybrid

  
at ford motor company, we believe freedom of movement drives human progress. we also believe in providing you with the freedom to define and realize your dreams. with our incredible plans for the future of mobility, we have an exciting opportunity for you to join our expanding area of telemetry and observability.


are you enthusiastic to mine raw data and realize its hidden value by architecting and building amazing, connected data solutions that benefit our customers? would you love to accelerate our efforts in implementing advanced agentic solutions and ml model in production?


the senior data scientist role resides within the ford’s electric vehicle organization. in this role, you will work on building scalable and robust data pipelines to process large volumes of manufacturing, repair, software update, call center case, and connected vehicle data to support the ford telemetry and observability initiatives.

* collaborate across teams and internal organizations to develop a wider data architecture plan for all of connected vehicle software.
* work with data stewards and data owners to source and understand data to ensure the best data transformation practices and processes.
* collaborate with data analytics stakeholders to streamline the data acquisition, processing, and presentation process.
* provide analysis of connected vehicle data to support new product developments and production vehicle improvements.
* contribute to the design and building of a semantic data layer to serve ai agents.
* work with ml ops to design and implement robust, scalable data science and machine learning operations (mlops) pipelines primarily within cloud environments like google cloud platform (gcp) and amazon web services (aws), ensuring efficient deployment and maintenance of ai solutions.
* lead the integration of new cloud technologies and ai tools (e.g., vertex ai) into our workflows, continuously evaluating their potential and articulating their business value to drive innovation and efficiency.
* acquire a deep understanding of vehicle engineering problems, translating them into appropriate mathematical representations and ai/ml solutions (classification, prediction, intelligent automation).
* develop and maintain a data quality system, ensuring the overall quality and integrity of data and solutions throughout the development lifecycle, from data collection and cleaning to model deployment.
* build data pipelines to monitoring quality of data and performance of analytical models and agentic solutions.
* stay current on the latest practices in ai agentic solutions.
* work cross\-functionally and have excellent technical interpretation skills to translate technical work to a variety of stakeholders.
* mentor more junior members of a data engineering team.

**you will have...**

* master’s degree or foreign equivalent degree in computer science, software engineering, information systems, data engineering, or a related field, and 4 years of experience or equivalent combination of education and experience (6\+ years with bachelor's degree).
* 4 years of professional experience in:
	+ data engineering, data product development and software product launches
	+ at least three of the following languages: java, python, spark, scala, sql
	+ 3 years of cloud data/software engineering experience building scalable, reliable, and cost\-effective production batch and streaming data pipelines using:
	+ data warehouses like amazon redshift, microsoft azure synapse analytics, google bigquery.
	+ workflow orchestration tools like airflow.

* cloud networking \& security – l4/l7 load balancing, tls termination, reverse‑proxy (nginx/envoy), mtls between services, and automated cert lifecycle (acme/let’s encrypt).

* ai/llm pipelines – building prompt‑engineering workflows, pii anonymization, and monitoring azure openai (or comparable) usage, rate limits \& cost.
* api‑gateway operations – custom webhook/rest integrations, circuit‑breaker patterns, rate‑limiting, auto‑retry and health‑checking.
* observability \& finops – end‑to‑end monitoring with datadog, prometheus/grafana or azure monitor; proactive cost‑optimization and 24/7 incident response (sla/slo).

description:
**about us**

  

at exxonmobil, our vision is to lead in energy innovations that advance modern living and a net\-zero future. as one of the world’s largest publicly traded energy and chemical companies, we are powered by a unique and diverse workforce fueled by the pride in what we do and what we stand for.

  

the success of our upstream, product solutions and low carbon solutions businesses is the result of the talent, curiosity and drive of our people. they bring solutions every day to optimize our strategy in energy, chemicals, lubricants and lower\-emissions technologies.

  

we invite you to bring your ideas to exxonmobil to help create sustainable solutions that improve quality of life and meet society’s evolving needs. learn more about **our what and our why** and how we canwork **together**.

**what role you will play in our team**
---------------------------------------

  

* work on complex ai use cases from ideation and discovery through deployment and sustainment as part of integrated, enterprise\-level teams.
* collaborate with exxonmobil subject matter experts to strengthen organizational capabilities in ai/ml.
* support business teams in making impactful, data\-driven decisions.
**what you will do**
--------------------

  

* lead the scoping, design, development, and deployment of ai/ml solutions, primarily focused on generative ai applications for subsurface and well\-related operations.
* collaborate with data and machine learning engineers to operationalize models and ensure seamless integration with existing digital infrastructure.
* build and deploy ai system components (such as chatbots, agents, and other workflow automation components) capable of interacting with diverse data sources and providing insightful information to users.
* develop and implement solutions involving orchestration of multiple ai agents to achieve complex tasks.
* apply domain knowledge and physical principles to improve model accuracy and reliability.
* contribute to the growth of internal ai capabilities by sharing expertise and developing best practices.
* provide technical mentorship and guidance to colleagues across teams.
* work closely with team leads and subject matter experts to align on project priorities, strategy, and solution design.
* optimize end to end ai solutions to enhance performance, usability, and cost
* work closely with business to understand business problem and translate that into mathematical framework. also, work with business to help enhance business adaptability for the solution.
* validate ai system responses, including troubleshooting prompt engineering, agentic workflows and other aspects of a genai system.
* develop process and automation for accelerating validation of ai systems, while ensuring the proper degree of accuracy is maintained.
**about you**
-------------

 **skills / qualifications**

  

* 5\+ years of professional experience in developing and deploying ai/ml solutions, with a strong emphasis on
* generative ai technologies and a solid background in applying these methods to physical systems and engineering workflows.
* deep expertise in natural language processing (nlp), large language models (llms), and building agentic workflows for generative ai with the ability to understand underlying mathematics and develop novel algorithms.
* solid understanding of knowledge graphs, ontologies, and semantic technologies.

title: Power BI Engineer
description:
**req id:** 385120
  
  

ntt data strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. if you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  

we are currently seeking a power bi engineer to join our team in dallas, texas (us\-tx), united states (us). plesae note that this role is slated to be on\-site 5 days/week.
  
  

**responsibilities:**  

requirements gathering analysis
  
collaborate with business stakeholders, department heads, and executive leadership to gather, document, and analyze business intelligence and reporting requirements; translate business questions into technical specifications for data models, dashboards, and analytical solutions.
  
  

data modeling architecture
  
design and develop logical and physical data models (star schema, snowflake schema) to support enterprise reporting needs; define fact and dimension tables, establish relationships, and optimize data structures for query performance and scalability.
  
  

etl/data pipeline development
  
design, build, and maintain extract, transform, load (etl/elt) processes to consolidate data from multiple heterogeneous source systems (e.g., sql server, oracle, sap, salesforce, cloud data warehouses) into centralized data warehouses or data marts, ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and integrity.
  
  

power bi dashboard report development
  
design, develop, and deploy interactive dashboards, scorecards, and reports using microsoft power bi, including:
  
building complex dax (data analysis expressions) measures, calculated columns, and calculated tables for advanced business metrics (kpis, yoy/mom trends, running totals, variance analysis)
  
developing and optimizing power query (m language) transformations for data cleansing, shaping, and integration
  
constructing and maintaining power bi data models using best practices for relationships, cardinality, and row\-level security (rls)
  
publishing and managing reports/datasets via the power bi service, configuring scheduled data refreshes, gateways (on\-premises data gateway), and workspace access controls
  
creating reusable power bi templates, custom visuals, and paginated reports (power bi report builder) for standardized enterprise reporting
  
implementing power bi premium/fabric capacity optimization techniques to manage performance for large datasets
  
  

sql development database querying
  
write and optimize complex sql queries, stored procedures, views, and functions to extract, aggregate, and analyze large datasets from relational databases; perform query performance tuning and indexing recommendations.
  
  

data analysis statistical interpretation
  
conduct quantitative and qualitative analysis of business data to identify trends, patterns, correlations, and anomalies; apply statistical methods to support forecasting, variance analysis, and root\-cause investigation of business performance issues.
  
  

kpi development performance metrics
  
partner with business units (finance, sales, operations, risk, or client delivery) to define, standardize, and track key performance indicators (kpis) and metrics aligned with organizational strategic goals.
  
  

data governance quality assurance
  
establish and enforce data quality standards, validation rules, and reconciliation processes; document data lineage, business logic, and metadata to maintain a single source of truth across reporting platforms.
  
  

cross\-functional collaboration
  
work closely with data engineers, database administrators, software developers, and business analysts to ensure bi solutions integrate seamlessly with enterprise data architecture and align with it governance standards.
  
  

ad hoc self\-service analytics enablement
  
develop self\-service bi capabilities by training business users on power bi report consumption and basic report authoring; create documentation, data dictionaries, and user guides to support organizational bi adoption.
  
  

presentation of insights to leadership
  
prepare and present analytical findings, dashboards, and business recommendations to senior management and executive stakeholders to support data\-driven decision\-making.
  
  

tool technology evaluation
  
evaluate and recommend bi tools, visualization techniques, and emerging technologies (e.g., power bi, tableau, azure synapse, microsoft fabric, python/r for advanced analytics) to enhance the organization's business intelligence capabilities.
  
  

security compliance
  
implement role\-based access controls and row\-level security within bi platforms to ensure sensitive business and financial data is accessed only by authorized personnel, in compliance with organizational and regulatory data governance policies.
  
  

documentation change management
  
maintain technical documentation for bi solutions including data flow diagrams, source\-to\-target mappings, and version control of power bi reports/datasets; manage change requests and enhancements through a structured sdlc/agile process.
  
  

required qualifications
  
* bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, data analytics, engineering, or related field.
* 5–7 years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, or reporting.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience with power bi desktop and power bi service.
* 2\+ years experience in in dax, power query (m), and sql.


preferred qualifications
  
* knowledge of python, power automate, or automation frameworks.
* familiarity with ci/cd pipelines and azure devops.
* experience with dimensional modeling, star schemas, and semantic models.
* strong understanding of data warehousing concepts.
* experience working with large datasets and performance optimization techniques.
* excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* strong communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* experience in banking, financial services, risk analytics, or capital markets.
* microsoft certified: power bi data analyst associate certification preferred.

this position may also be eligible for incentive compensation based on individual and/or company performance.
