title: Container Platform Engineer
description:
**container platform engineer\- remote**  

  

bright vision technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, ai, data, and enterprise solutions across the united states.  

this is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well\-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.  

  

**job title:** container platform engineer  

**location:** 100% remote (u.s.)  

**position type:** full\-time, direct w2  

**salary range:** $100,000–$150,000 annually  

**experience required:** 6\+ years  

  

**sponsorship:** u.s. citizens, green card holders, ead holders, and h\-1b transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. we are unable to sponsor new h\-1b visa petitions for this position.  

  

**job summary**  

we are seeking an experienced container platform engineer to design, deploy, and operate enterprise\-grade red hat openshift container platforms running mission\-critical workloads across on\-premises and cloud environments. in this role you will own the end\-to\-end platform lifecycle — from cluster provisioning and hardening, through workload onboarding and developer enablement, to ongoing operations and continuous improvement. the ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in openshift and kubernetes internals, strong linux fundamentals, and a security\-first mindset, and will partner with application teams, security engineers, and infrastructure stakeholders to deliver a stable, secure, and developer\-friendly container platform.  

  

**key responsibilities*** architect, provision, and operate red hat openshift clusters across on\-premises, virtualized, and major cloud environments, applying best practices for high availability, scalability, and security.
* design and implement multi\-tenant openshift platforms with appropriate project isolation, network policies, quotas, rbac, and security context constraints.
* automate cluster lifecycle operations — installation, upgrades, scaling, and decommissioning — using openshift installer, gitops tooling (argo cd, openshift gitops), and iac frameworks.
* onboard application development teams to the platform, providing clear self\-service patterns, project templates, ci/cd integrations, and supporting documentation.
* operate openshift networking, including sdn/ovn\-kubernetes, ingress controllers, routes, network policies, and integration with enterprise firewalls and load balancers.
* manage openshift storage strategies (block, file, object), including dynamic provisioning, openshift data foundation, and integration with external storage platforms.
* implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and tracing using the openshift observability stack (prometheus, grafana, efk, tempo) and integrate with enterprise siem and apm tools.
* harden the platform in collaboration with security teams, including image scanning (quay/clair), runtime protection, secret management, and continuous compliance with regulatory frameworks.
* design and maintain robust ci/cd pipelines on openshift using tekton, jenkins, gitlab ci, or argo workflows, enabling safe and frequent application deployments.
* develop disaster\-recovery and backup strategies for cluster state, etcd, and persistent workloads, validated through regular failover and restore drills.
* plan, test, and execute cluster upgrades across minor and major versions with minimal disruption to workloads, including pre\-upgrade validation and rollback strategies.
* partner with application teams to right\-size workloads, manage resource quotas, and tune cluster autoscaling for predictable performance and cost efficiency.
* continuously evolve platform tooling and developer experience, capturing feedback from internal users and translating it into roadmap improvements.
* mentor junior engineers and act as an openshift subject\-matter expert across the broader organization.

**required qualifications*** bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* five or more years of experience operating container platforms in production, with at least three years on red hat openshift.
* deep, hands\-on knowledge of kubernetes and openshift internals, including operators, crds, rbac, and networking.
* strong linux administration skills, including networking, performance tuning, and troubleshooting.
* hands\-on experience with infrastructure\-as\-code tools such as ansible, terraform, or helm.
* solid experience implementing ci/cd pipelines on openshift or kubernetes using tekton, jenkins, or argo cd.
* strong scripting skills in bash, python, or go.
* working knowledge of cluster monitoring, logging, and tracing tools.
* familiarity with container image security and supply chain hardening.
* excellent troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.

**preferred qualifications*** red hat certified specialist in openshift administration or architect\-level red hat certification.
* experience operating openshift on at least one major public cloud (aws, azure, gcp).
* exposure to service mesh implementations (openshift service mesh, istio, linkerd).
* familiarity with regulated environments such as pci\-dss, hipaa, or soc 2\.
* experience with gitops workflows using argo cd or flux.

title: Cybersecurity Engineer
description:
responsibilities:**position summary**
--------------------


the senior cybersecurity engineer is a senior technical contributor responsible for designing, implementing, automating, and continuously improving cybersecurity capabilities across the enterprise. this role reduces organizational risk by combining expertise in vulnerability management, offensive security, security engineering, cloud security, secure software development, and ai\-enabled security technologies.
operating within a highly regulated healthcare environment, this position partners closely with infrastructure, cloud, enterprise architecture, application development, data, clinical technology, security operations, and third\-party risk management teams to protect critical systems, patient data, and business operations. the ideal candidate possesses strong technical skills, a security\-first mindset, advanced coding and automation capabilities, and experience leveraging artificial intelligence to improve cyber defense outcomes.**essential duties and responsibilities**
-----------------------------------------

* lead enterprise vulnerability management activities across endpoints, servers, cloud platforms, applications, databases, network infrastructure, and medical devices.
* develop and maintain risk\-based processes for vulnerability prioritization, remediation tracking, validation, reporting, and exposure reduction.
* perform application, api, network, cloud, active directory, wireless, and infrastructure security assessments.
* design, implement, and support security technologies including edr/xdr, siem, soar, cspm, identity security, email security, network security, and data protection platforms.
* engineer, automate, and integrate security controls across cloud, on\-premises, saas, and hybrid environments.
* develop custom scripts, apis, workflows, dashboards, and automation capabilities to improve detection, remediation, reporting, threat intelligence processing, and operational efficiency.
* integrate security throughout the software development lifecycle through secure development practices, threat modeling, security testing, and devsecops automation.
* collaborate with development teams to improve secure coding practices and remediate security findings.
* evaluate, implement, and optimize ai\-enabled security capabilities that improve threat detection, phishing analysis, vulnerability prioritization, investigations, threat hunting, and incident response.
* assess security risks associated with emerging technologies, ai platforms, large language models, agents, and automation solutions.
* participate in security architecture reviews, technology evaluations, project initiatives, and enterprise transformation programs.
* partner with security operations, incident response, infrastructure, cloud, architecture, and application teams to improve security controls and reduce organizational risk.
* support regulatory, audit, compliance, and third\-party risk management activities in alignment with healthcare security requirements.
* develop technical standards, policies, playbooks, runbooks, baselines, and engineering documentation.
* provide technical leadership, mentoring, and subject matter expertise to engineers, analysts, and project teams.
* create executive and operational metrics that demonstrate risk reduction, program maturity, vulnerability remediation progress, and security effectiveness.


qualifications:

---------------------------

### **education**

* bachelor's degree in cybersecurity, computer science, information systems, engineering, or related technical discipline.
* an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.

### **experience**

* 8\+ years of progressive cybersecurity experience.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on cybersecurity engineering experience.
* demonstrated success operating in large, complex enterprise environments.
* experience within healthcare, financial services, or other highly regulated industries preferred.
* experience leading complex technical initiatives, influencing cross\-functional execution, and delivering measurable security outcomes.

**technical skills \& expertise**
---------------------------------

* advanced knowledge of vulnerability management programs, exposure management methodologies, and remediation lifecycle processes.
* demonstrated offensive security experience including penetration testing, adversary emulation, attack simulation, exploitation techniques, and security validation.
* strong understanding of application security, devsecops, secure coding practices, owasp top 10, sast, dast, sca, threat modeling, and ci/cd security integration.
* experience securing microsoft azure, aws, and hybrid cloud environments.
* expertise in identity and access management, authentication technologies, secrets management, encryption, network segmentation, and zero trust principles.
* experience designing, implementing, and supporting edr/xdr, siem, soar, email security, dlp, cspm, vulnerability management, identity security, and data protection platforms.
* strong proficiency in python, powershell, javascript, go, bash, c\#, or similar programming languages.
* experience developing apis, integrations, automation solutions, and infrastructure\-as\-code security controls.
* knowledge of container security, kubernetes security, cloud\-native security architectures, and modern application environments.
* experience leveraging ai\-enabled security solutions, genai technologies, security copilots, machine learning concepts, prompt engineering, and intelligent automation capabilities.
* knowledge of threat intelligence, threat hunting, digital forensics, and incident response methodologies.
* familiarity with healthcare regulatory requirements including hipaa, hitech, nist, hitrust, cis controls, and related frameworks.
* strong technical writing, risk communication, and executive presentation capabilities.
* ability to evaluate emerging technologies and rapidly adapt to evolving cybersecurity threats and defensive capabilities.

**preferred certifications**

* giac gpen

* giac gxpn

* oswe
* gcih
* gcfa
* ccsp
* azure security engineer associate

**core competencies**

* strategic thinking with hands\-on execution capability
* strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* excellent written and verbal communication skills
* ability to communicate effectively with technical and executive audiences
* high degree of integrity, accountability, and professionalism
* strong collaboration and relationship\-building skills
* continuous learning mindset and adaptability
* ability to influence outcomes across cross\-functional teams
* results\-driven focus on measurable risk reduction

title: Salesforce Engineer
description:
**salesforce engineer at upstate coin and gold**


have you ever thought about a career in the fast\-paced gold and silver industry? if so, here is your golden opportunity and the timing couldn’t be better! upstate coin \& gold is offering an exceptional opportunity to become an expert in the exciting precious metals profession.




we are seeking an experienced **salesforce engineer** to join our team in a hybrid remote role. this position is based out of our **boulder, colorado** office, with travel to our **centennial, colorado** headquarters when needed.




**the role**


we are seeking a visionary salesforce engineer to lead the architectural design, development, and implementation of our new salesforce instance from the ground up. this is a foundational, architect\-level role, not a maintenance position. you will serve as the primary builder of our crm ecosystem, building the scalable architecture that powers our trading and customer operations.




we are looking for a true builder—someone who thrives on laying the groundwork for a growing organization and is passionate about establishing long\-term best practices. you must possess a "security\-first" mindset and demonstrate deep expertise in complex data orchestration, specifically in utilizing **mulesoft** to seamlessly bridge salesforce with our **netsuite erp**. if you are ready to own a critical platform build from day one, we want to hear from you.




**key responsibilities**

* **greenfield implementation:** own the full lifecycle of a new salesforce instance implementation, from initial discovery and schema design to deployment and post\-launch optimization.
* **enterprise integration:** architect and maintain sophisticated, real\-time integrations between salesforce and netsuite using mulesoft (anypoint platform) to ensure seamless data flow across our financial ecosystem.
* **engineering excellence:** develop high\-quality, scalable code using apex, lightning web components (lwc), and flow, adhering to industry best practices (ci/cd via salesforce dx, tdd, and clean code).
* **data integrity \& governance:** establish rigorous data governance policies to ensure "golden record" accuracy between crm and erp systems, prioritizing transactional integrity for commodity trading.
* **strategic leadership:** collaborate with stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into technical solutions, providing mentorship to junior team members and driving technical accountability.
* **platform administration:** perform hands\-on administrative salesforce tasks, including user management, permission sets, profile configuration, and daily platform health monitoring.
* **salesforce expertise:** 4\-6 years of professional engineering experience within the salesforce ecosystem, with a proven track record of implementing new instances from scratch.
* **mulesoft mastery:** expert\-level experience with mulesoft anypoint platform for designing, building, and managing apis and integrations required. you understand how to handle high\-concurrency data syncs between disparate systems.
* **erp orchestration:** deep, hands\-on experience integrating salesforce with **netsuite** (or similar tier\-1 erps). you understand the nuances of syncing gl accounts, inventory, and order fulfillment data.
* **development \& tooling:** expert command of **apex, lwc, javascript, and salesforce dx**. you are comfortable working in a modern dev environment using vs code and git\-based version control.
* **security \& compliance:** deep understanding of salesforce shield, advanced sharing models, and encryption to protect sensitive financial and customer data.
* **education \& certifications:** bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field required; **salesforce certified application/system architect** or **mulesoft developer** certifications are highly desirable.
* hands\-on, end\-to\-end development experience, from requirements gathering to post\-deployment support.
* experience in regulated environments (e.g., government cloud, financial services) is highly valued.




**differentiators**

* **full\-stack familiarity:** experience with node.js or aws services (lambda, sqs) to support off\-platform processing and event\-driven architectures.
* **domain expertise:** previous experience in **financial services**, **fintech**, or **commodities** (understanding of ledger logic, physical asset tracking, or tax compliance).
* **ai augmentation:** experience utilizing salesforce einstein or llm\-based development tools (e.g., cursor, copilot) to accelerate delivery velocity.
* **agile management:** experience leading technical sprints and managing complex backlogs in a fast\-paced environment.
* **modern innovation:** experience with agentforce, salesforce einstein, or leveraging llm\-based development tools to accelerate delivery.
* **reusable architecture:** proven ability to build modular, scalable components for long\-term platform maintenance.




**core technologies**

* **platform:** salesforce (sales cloud, service cloud, experience cloud)
* **integration:** mulesoft anypoint platform, rest/soap apis
* **languages:** apex, javascript (lwc), soql/sosl
* **erp ecosystem:** netsuite (suitetalk, rest web services)
* **devops:** salesforce dx, github actions, copado (or similar)




**professional attributes**

* **hands\-on developer:** you thrive in the weeds of code and configuration, preferring a keyboard\-first approach to solving problems.
* **meticulous attention to detail:** in the gold and silver industry, a decimal point matters. you exhibit a passion for data precision and system reliability.
* **security\-first mindset:** you architect solutions with the assumption that data is the company's most valuable asset, ensuring robust protection at every layer.
* **high\-velocity execution:** ability to make sound architectural decisions quickly in a high\-stakes, commodity\-trading environment.
* **effective communicator:** ability to explain complex technical trade\-offs to non\-technical executive stakeholders.
* **self\-starter and motivator:** you possess an innate drive to own projects from inception to completion and have the ability to motivate cross\-functional teams to align on technical goals.




**what we offer**

* **retirement security:** 401(k) with a **6% company match**
* **comprehensive health:** medical, dental, and vision plans; hsa and fsa options.
* **insurance \& protection:** company\-paid std, ltd, life, and ad\&d insurance.
* **work\-life balance:** paid time off (accruing immediately) plus paid holidays and sick pay.
* **perks \& culture:** employee discounts on precious metals.

**job type:** full\-time exempt

**location:** hybrid (boulder/centennial, co)

here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. our five behaviors\-traveler first, think big, operate with excellence, ownership mindset, and succeed together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. join us and build for travelers everywhere.


our technology team partners with teams across expedia group to create innovative products, services, and tools to deliver high\-quality experiences for travelers, partners, and our employees. a singular technology platform powered by data and machine learning provides secure, differentiated, and personalized experiences that drive loyalty and traveler satisfaction.
  

  

at expedia group fraud \& risk (efr), we are the guardians of marketplace trust. we protect eg from financial loss and brand damage, securing every channel for our customers, partners, suppliers, and employees. our world‑class engineering and machine learning turn massive, noisy signals into real‑time decisions that minimize risk while keeping traveler friction low.
  

  

what makes this work unique: in travel, risk doesn’t stop at checkout, it spans the entire journey. the global ecosystem is vast and fragmented, control points are scarce, and every leg introduces new unknowns. our mission is bold: deliver a fully trusted journey from purchase to safe return home. that’s hard and exactly why science and technology matter most.
  

  

if you’re energized by complex, high‑impact problems with no obvious answers, and want to shape the future of risk with ai on a global scale, join us. let’s redefine how the world travels, safely, confidently, and at speed.
  

  

**software development engineer ii**  

  

help develop real\-time, ai\-powered fraud and abuse defenses on a global scale. you will build cloud\-native decisioning and automated remediation systems, simplify our platform, and be a part of our journey to become an ai\-first technology organization.
  

  

**in this role, you will:**

* develop software modules for automated risk decisioning and remediation at scale.
* benchmark various vendor, open source and in\-house solutions for performance, cost and risk posture.
* partner closely with data and ml scientists on features, experimentation, and monitoring of models.
* partner closely with other engineering teams on the delivery of business outcomes through code.
* integrate ai solutions into our technology platform, building from scratch where applicable.
* engage in efforts to improve technical operations and processes of the team through automation.

  

**minimum qualifications:**

* bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience.
* at least 1 year of professional software engineering experience, with strong coding skills in jvm\-based languages (java or scala) and experience applying object\-oriented design principles.
* familiarity with distributed cloud\-native engineering (aws, gcp, or azure), microservices, api development, sql/nosql databases.
* some knowledge of streaming and data processing frameworks such as kafka, flink and spark.
* experience in monitoring and debugging production\-grade software.
* ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to stakeholders with or without a technical background.

  

**preferred qualifications:**

* some experience working with a variety of stakeholders: product, program, data, ml science and quality control.
* curiosity and a strong desire to learn, innovate and unlock the potential of modern ai\-based productivity tools.
* hands\-on experience using ai coding assistants and agents (e.g., claude code, cursor, github copilot, or equivalent) to ship production software faster
* experience working with llms, among other gen ai solutions.
* domain experience in risk and fraud within marketplace, travel and e\-commerce.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**our purpose**

*mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. we support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**title and summary**


senior software engineer
job overview:
  

responsible for the analysis, design, development, testing, and delivery of secure, scalable software solutions. define requirements for new applications and customization adhering to mastercard standards, processes, and best practices. develop, customize, and test applications to integrate to mastercard specifications. provide leadership, mentoring, and technical training to other team members.
  

  

major accountabilities
  

* plan, design, architect, and develop secure, scalable, and maintainable technical solutions and alternatives to meet business requirements in adherence with mastercard standards, processes, and best practices
* lead day\-to\-day system development and maintenance activities of the team to meet service level agreements (slas) and create solutions with a high level of innovation, cost effectiveness, quality, reliability, and faster time to market.
* accountable for the full systems development life cycle including creating high\-quality requirements documents, use cases, designs, and other technical artifacts including but not limited to detailed test strategies, performance benchmarking, release rollout and deployment plans, contingency/back\-out plans, feasibility studies, cost and time analysis, and detailed estimates.
* design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain software applications while applying software engineering best practices, secure coding standards, and effective use of data structures
* perform system maintenance, production incident management, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, remediation, and on\-call support while ensuring operational reliability and observability
* select appropriate technical frameworks and solution delivery methodologies. adapt technical artifact templates based on project and technology needs. contribute ideas to help ensure required standards and processes are in place. maintain solution and technology roadmaps
* research and evaluate current and upcoming technologies and frameworks.
* participate in pocs (proof of concept) and help the department with selection of vendor solutions, technologies, methodologies, and frameworks.
* collaborate with vendor resources for product support
* conduct brownbag sessions on new and upcoming technologies, methodologies, and application\-appropriate frameworks. ensure knowledge transfer of vendor technology to mastercard staff and provide technical training to team members
* follow and promote quality assurance and quality control processes in the department. actively look for opportunities to enhance standards and improve process efficiency. mentor and guide team members during all phases of the sdlc
* ensure adequate test coverage through unit, functional, integration, and performance testing. perform quality inspections and walkthroughs throughout the sdlc including requirements reviews, design reviews, code reviews, and security reviews to ensure compliance with mastercard standards.
* coordinate offshore development and manage day\-to\-day activities.

  

all about you  

* strong understanding of software design, architecture, data structures, secure development practices, testing, and performance optimization.
* strong programming and automation skills using java, groovy, or similar languages
* experience designing, building, testing, deploying, and maintaining software applications using engineering best practices.
* strong understanding of service\-oriented, microservices, and api\-driven architectures
* experience building and supporting scalable backend services, apis, and distributed systems
* experience designing, building, and maintaining ci/cd pipelines to enable reliable, automated, and high\-quality software delivery.
* hands\-on experience with devops tools such as git/bitbucket, jenkins, xlr, chef, artifactory, docker registry, and similar platforms
* experience automating infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, deployments, and operational workflows
* knowledge of observability, monitoring, logging, production support, and security best practices including authentication, authorization, secure api design, and data protection
* ability to collaborate effectively in a globally distributed engineering environment to improve software delivery processes
* demonstrate a continuous learning mindset with interest in ai\-driven automation, innovation, and operational efficiency

  

education
  

* bachelor's degree in information systems, information technology, computer science, engineering, or equivalent work experience.

* complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Systems Design Engineer
Sr Analyst, Statistical Inference and Data Science (IKC)
description:
**posting date**


08/14/2026
2000 16th street, denver, colorado, 80202, united states of america
denver, colorado \| full\-time \| on\-site/hybrid
  

  

**about the team**
  

the commercial integrated care analytics team supports davita integrated kidney care (davita ikc). davita ikc is the renal population health management division of davita serving approximately 70,000 end stage renal disease (esrd) and late stage chronic kidney disease (ckd) patients across the u.s. a key component of davita’s integrated care strategy is our healthcare analytics team, responsible for developing and communicating advanced data analytics to inform program performance and model of care design.  



  

as a member of this team, you will be responsible for designing and executing rigorous statistical analyses and data science work that measures the causal impact of our care model on clinical and cost outcomes. this entails developing inferential frameworks, building predictive models, and communicating evidence\-based findings that drive care program decisions and value\-based contract performance.  



  

this role will work with teammates across various teams, ranging from analyst to clinicians and operators to executive leaders. the environment is highly collaborative and team\-oriented, with a differential focus on both professional and personal growth.
  

  

**essential duties and responsibilities**
  

the analyst must be able to work successfully with cross\-functional teams and have the maturity to interact directly with both peers and leaders across departments. the following duties and responsibilities generally reflect the expectations of this position, but are not intended to be all\-inclusive.


statistical inference \& study design


* design and execute observational studies using quasi\-experimental methods (e.g., difference\-in\-differences, propensity score matching, regression) to evaluate the impact of care interventions on clinical and cost outcomes
* build and interpret regression models (e.g., negative binomial, logistic, mixed\-effects) to estimate treatment effects and identify drivers of utilization and cost
* apply bayesian or frequentist inference frameworks to quantify uncertainty in program effectiveness estimates
* conduct power analyses and sample size calculations to support pilot study design and program evaluation planning
* develop analytic designs that translate operational research questions into well\-specified studies, including defining appropriate comparison groups and controlling for confounders

data science \& model measurement


* build, validate, and monitor predictive models (e.g., hospital readmission risk, disease progression, cost forecasting) that inform care management priorities and resource allocation
* develop and maintain model performance measurement frameworks, including calibration, discrimination, and fairness metrics, to ensure models remain accurate and actionable over time
* conduct feature engineering using clinical, claims, and demographic data to improve model performance and interpretability
* evaluate and compare modeling approaches (e.g., penalized regression, gradient boosting, survival analysis) with attention to explainability and clinical relevance
* partner with operations and clinical teams to translate model outputs into practical decision support tools and intervention triggers

ai integration \& workflow innovation


* incorporate large language models and ai\-assisted tooling into analytic workflows to accelerate code development, literature review, documentation, and exploratory analysis
* evaluate emerging ai tools and methods for applicability to healthcare analytics use cases, including automated feature selection, synthetic data generation, and natural language processing of clinical notes
* develop and share best practices for responsible ai use within the analytics team, including prompt engineering, output validation, and appropriate use\-case scoping
  

communication \& stakeholder engagement
* produce clear, technically sound documentation of analytic methods, assumptions, and limitations
* develop executive\-level communications that translate complex statistical findings into actionable insights for clinical, financial, and operational stakeholders
* partner with stakeholders to define technical and business requirements for reporting and analytic requests
* leverage reporting and supporting data to monitor operations performance and identify insights around clinical, demographic, and medical cost trends and their contribution to outcomes

characteristics and competencies


* build relationships with both internal and external partners and clients to ensure the success of ikc programs
* embrace working in a fast\-paced environment with comfort navigating ambiguity
* focus on analytical process improvement and methodological rigor
* a self\-starter mentality and thoughtful execution abilities
* strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts to non\-technical audiences
* excellent organizational and prioritization skills
* intellectual curiosity with demonstrated interest and strengths in data analysis, statistical methods, and innovation

**qualifications**


* master’s degree preferred in biostatistics, epidemiology, economics, statistics, data science, or a quantitative field
* bachelor’s degree required in a quantitative discipline (statistics, mathematics, economics, computer science, public health, or related field)
* 2\-4 years of applied experience with causal inference, program evaluation, or health services research methods is required
* 1\+ year of experience with sql and querying relational databases containing clinical or claims data is required
* proficiency in python or r for statistical modeling, not limited to data manipulation, is required
* working knowledge of regression modeling for count, binary, and time\-to\-event outcomes
* familiarity with healthcare claims data structures (medical, pharmacy, eligibility) preferred

preferred / nice to have


* experience with version control (git) and reproducible research practices
* experience with tableau or similar analytics visualization tools
* demonstrated comfort using ai/llm tools (e.g., chatgpt, claude, copilot) to enhance analytic productivity
* familiarity with machine learning model evaluation and monitoring (e.g., auroc, brier scores, calibration curves)
* experience developing presentations in powerpoint or similar tools for executive audiences
* excel proficiency including pivot tables and data manipulation

what to expect when you join our village


* a “community first, company second” culture based on core values that really matter
* clinical outcomes consistently ranked above the national average
* award\-winning education and training across multiple career paths to help you reach your potential
* performance\-based rewards based on stellar individual and team contributions
* a comprehensive benefits package designed to enhance your health, your financial well\-being, and your future
* dedication, above all, to caring for patients suffering from kidney failure and other chronic disease across the nation

**what we’ll provide**


more than just pay, our davita rewards package connects teammates to what matters most. teammates are eligible to begin receiving benefits on the first day of the month following or coinciding with one month of continuous employment. below are some of our benefit offerings.


* comprehensive benefits: medical, dental, vision, 401(k) match, paid time off, pto cash out

* professional development programs: davita offers a variety of programs to help strong performers grow within their career and also offers on\-demand virtual leadership and development courses through davita’s online training platform star learning

at davita, we strive to be a community first and a company second. we want all teammates to experience davita as "a place where i belong." our goal is to embed belonging into everything we do in our village, so that it becomes part of who we are. we are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and comply with state and federal affirmative action requirements. individuals are recruited, hired, assigned and promoted without regard to race, national origin, religion, age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

title: Senior Solutions Engineer, Google Cloud & Maps Platform
description:
**about us**


founded in 1866, the sanborn map company (sanborn) is one of the oldest continuously operating mapping and geospatial information technology companies in the us. our work is highly visual, and our mapped data and applications are an essential part of today’s information economy. we serve many industries and government departments and need to communicate effectively with them about our wide range of products and services. we remain at the forefront of the gis and photogrammetry industry by offering high quality, technologically superior products and services backed by the industry’s most experienced staff. we are looking for a talented individual to fill this role working in a collaborative environment ready to innovate workflow.


**summary**


the senior solutions engineer, google cloud \& maps platform supports the spatial intelligence sales organization as a trusted technical advisor, solution architect, and partner facing expert for google cloud platform (gcp) and google maps platform solutions. the position will collaborate with new and existing high\-value clients to document and comprehend use case requirements, devising custom solutions which leverage the full capabilities of sanborn geospatial and partner solutions. this role is sales aligned and revenue focused, operating within a google partner / reseller motion. works closely with account executives, google partner teams, and customers to drive solution adoption, accelerate deal cycles, and articulate differentiated business value using cloud and geospatial technologies. the position requires in\-depth knowledge to co\-sell with google, position partner led solutions, and translate technical capabilities into commercial outcomes.


**position location:** remote (u.s.\-based)


**key responsibilities**



technical sales ownership


* own the technical sale alongside account executives, from first discovery call through technical close and clean handoff to delivery.
* serve as lead technical advisor to commercial and government customers on new business, expansion, and upsell.
* handle the technical objections that stall deals: architecture fit, data residency, terms of service limits, integration effort, and total cost at volume.

google partner co\-sell


* lead technical execution in google cloud and google maps platform co\-sell motions — joint customer calls, solution workshops, and partner\-led demos.
* position sanborn's services, ip, and managed offerings alongside google technologies to articulate differentiated partner value.
* stay current on google partner programs, solution playbooks, pricing models, and incentive structures that impact deal strategy.


solution architecture \& design


* design solutions on google maps platform apis covering mapping, places, routing, geocoding, and the bigquery\-native insights products.
* design the supporting google cloud footprint, with emphasis on bigquery, data pipelines, and gemini or vertex ai where the use case calls for it.
* model consumption and unit economics so the architecture the customer buys is one they can afford at scale and one sanborn can deliver at margin.

demonstrations \& proofs of concept


* build and deliver working demonstrations on google cloud and google maps platform that connect a technical capability to a dollar outcome the customer recognizes.
* run proofs of concept and pilots against real customer data, scoped to close a decision rather than to explore.
* create and maintain a reusable demonstration and reference\-architecture library so the motion is repeatable by others and does not live in one person’s head.

proposals, rfps \& deal support


* author technical content for proposals, statements of work, and responses to rfps, rfis, and sources\-sought notices, including public sector solicitations.
* supply the technical assumptions and usage drivers that pricing depends on.
* partner with delivery to confirm feasibility and risk before commitments are made.

**qualifications**


* google cloud in front of customers. hands\-on, customer\-facing experience with google cloud platform, plus working familiarity with google maps platform apis or a comparable location and mapping platform.
* built the demo. a demonstrable record of building and delivering a working demonstration or proof of concept, not just presenting one somebody else built, and connecting it to a commercial outcome.
* data fluency. working sql and comfort in bigquery or an equivalent cloud data warehouse. enough scripting in python or javascript to stand up a prototype.
* commercial instinct. a record of influencing or closing technical deals alongside sellers, and the ability to translate architecture into revenue, cost, and risk language an executive buyer uses.

**preferred qualifications**


* google cloud certification at associate or professional level, or the generative ai leader credential.
* gemini or vertex ai applied in a customer\-facing setting.
* geospatial background of any kind: gis, esri, imagery, lidar, remote sensing, surveying, or location data products.
* experience inside a partner, reseller, distributor, or channel model.
* consumption or usage\-based pricing, and usage forecasting.
* selling to state, local, or federal government, including cooperative contract vehicles.
* experience supporting isvs, saas providers, or enterprise platform customers.

**certifications**


* google cloud certifications (associate or professional levels) preferred.


**education:**

bachelor’s degree or higher from an accredited college or university or equivalent experience. a degree in computer science, geographic information science, engineering, data science, business, or a related field is preferred.


**experience:**

minimum of seven years in customer\-facing technical roles. qualifying backgrounds include pre\-sales or solutions engineering, sales engineering, technical account management, solution consulting, technical product management, and technical selling roles. experience in cloud, geospatial, data, or saas is preferred.


salary range: 110k \- 135k annual


**applicant must live in the u.s. and be authorized to work in the u.s.**


sanborn offers a comprehensive health and wellness program which includes medical, dental, vision, 401k, holiday, pto, eap, disability and life insurance benefits.
